annotations.title: ABI-decode calldata, return data or log data with known types or a signature

description: ABI-decode calldata, return data or log data with known types or a signature. Decodes hex data with a list of ABI types or a function signature (the 4-byte selector is stripped and checked when present). Strict: every offset and length is bounds-checked and dirty padding is rejected. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
